description: Variation of Condition 5 (Approved plans) attached to planning permission PL/0485/25 dated 02/05/2025 to remove upper floor developments and only extend on the ground floor
decision_conditions: <p>The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of planning permission PL/0485/25 dated 02.05.2025.</p>

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s), other than those shown on the approved plans shall be installed in the side elevation(s) of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.
The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.

<p>This permission shall have the effect of varying condition number 5 on approved application reference PL/0485/25 dated 02/05/2025. The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents: PLNGV 300, PLNGV 301, PLNGV 303, PLNGV 401, PLNGV 402, PLNGV 403, PLNGV 404, Covering Letter, Reasonable Exemption Statement, Location Plan&nbsp;</p>
